source.ref: OpenStreetMap public path graph; Qu4vsKXiRtM video
source.coordinate_provenance: OSM centreline, manual video/map anchors; no GPS
source.geometry_interpolation: OSM walk with non-observed dead-end excursions removed; observed 835s turnaround retained with explicit 5m radius. RDP 2m, corner trim <=8m, horizontal fitting window 8m; physical distances re-derived, not scaled.
source.elevation: Re-sampled after graph-spur repair: AWS Terrarium z14 bilinear; unresolved coastal values <1.5m use an estimated 1.5m path datum; median 41m / elevation box 111m; bridge explicitly estimated 3m ends / 8m centre with continuous along/cross-track approach blend; final 81m elevation joining filter. Grade is derived from the published physical profile; no visual exaggeration, no surveyed elevation claim.
source.video_alignment: estimated; adjacent anchor distance scaled only by the small corner-interpolation arc-length change
source.access_note: Historical video reconstruction includes mapped path geometry regardless of current access/bicycle restrictions; not a present-day routing recommendation.
source.estimated_paths: Northern Peninsula gravel loop absent from OSM path graph: manual video/map estimate, not GPS or OSM-measured geometry.
